name: Scene list and sequencer

dependencies.reason: Result/Status and the bounds-checked byte codec used by the list serializer

threading: Not thread-safe: own it from one thread (the plugin uses the message thread). The Sequencer allocates nothing after construction. Not real-time safe (the list owns vectors).
platforms: Any C++17 compiler. Depends only on chop_contracts.
standalone_test_command: cmake -S modules/scenes -B build/scenes && cmake --build build/scenes && ctest --test-dir build/scenes
summary: An ordered list of up to 32 scenes (opaque serialized pattern plus name, loop count and what follows) with stable ids, a validated byte codec, and a pure loop-boundary Sequencer that decides which scene to arm next (advance, repeat, jump, stop, wrap). It never parses the pattern bytes and never touches audio: the host arms and switches.
public_api: `serialize` / `deserialize` (schema 1 body; rejects truncation and bit damage)
limits: 32 scenes, 1 to 64 loops, names 1 to 32 bytes, 1 MiB per pattern, 32 MiB serialized list
adapters: Call `onBoundary()` once per observed pattern-loop boundary; arm the returned scene on the audio side and adopt it when the audio side reports the switch.
adapter_notes: The host owns pattern validation: it must parse every scene's bytes with its own pattern codec after `deserialize`.
removal: Delete the folder; callers lose scenes only.
